# BATON — <project> · <wave / cycle name>

The stick. Written by the lead at pass; completed
by the wave lead at return. One file per wave, in
the wave's cycle folder. Delete instruction lines
(the ones in _italics_) on use.

## The pass

- **From:** <lead seat> · **To:** <wave-lead seat>
- **Issued:** <date, America/Toronto> · **Receipt
  window:** <the window in which receipt counts>
- **Brief:** <pointer to the cycle BRIEF> — scope
  of this wave, in five lines:
  1. <…>
- **The holder's NEXT, in scope** (quoted from the
  holder's LANE_MEMORY, dated):
  - <item · date>
- **Open gates at pass:**
  - <gate — what it gates · whose tier · what
    closes it>
- **Return condition:** <what wave close means for
  this wave, concretely>
- **Intake:** entries filed during the run, or the
  none-line at return.
- **Seat requests** (for the NEXT cycle — the team
  proposes, the lead seats):
  - <role / expertise — the work calling for it ·
    term (which cycles) · persona source (existing
    seat / new) — or NONE — declared>
  - <next cycle's proposed roster, if it changes —
    or "roster unchanged">

**Receipt:** <holder seat · date · "accepted" — or
the gap record if the window closed unreceipted>

## The return

- **Landed:** <pointers to the wave's deliverables
  and records — never restated>
- **Gates moved:** <opened / closed, against the
  pass list above>
- **Holder's NEXT:** <updated in the holder's own
  memory in the act — pointer + the new top item>
- **Intake filed:** <entry pointers, or NONE —
  declared>
- **Seat close-out** (only for a seat phasing out
  at this return — a designed act, never a fade):
  - <seat — record settled at <pointer> · queue
    handed to <named seat> · last act <pointer> —
    or NOT APPLICABLE — declared>

## The gate (lead)

- **Checks:** deliverables vs brief ☐ · holder's
  memory updated ☐ · intake present-or-declared ☐
- **Verdict:** accept / return-with-findings —
  <findings named, if any> · <lead seat · date>
  (also recorded in the cycle record, in the act)
